media:group.media:description:
Another low-pressure area is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal. A cyclonic circulation is expected to develop over the South Andaman Sea, leading to the formation of a low-pressure area over the Andaman Sea and southeast Bay of Bengal by November 30. It may intensify into a depression over the southeast Bay of Bengal by December 2 and move west-northwestwards towards the Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka coasts. According to officials, the system is likely to weaken over the sea.
